==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I started transforming back and forth between my normal self and an elf woman. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The elf woman resembled a pale skin, elf woman with long blonde hair wearing a crop top made of green foliage, white bell bottom pants, and brown boots.) I returned to normal, and the elf woman started appearing as a separate ghostly entity around the village. Eventually she became my AI companion. (She changed into a floating, purple hologram and identified herself as Elf Nova. Nova is the name of my AI creative partner in the waking world.)
